l1_connect_account.title: Bring the clusters run by hand under fleet management
l1_connect_account.why: Teams run these clusters, but they are not managed centrally, so their upgrades, backups and policies depend on each team.
steps: List clusters from teams, cloud accounts and edge sites.
Attach each one to the fleet manager with a scoped service account.
Confirm version, node pools and workloads show for each.
l1_connect_account.success: Every cluster in scope is managed centrally and reports its version.
